app_id.description: App ID for your OAuth 2.0 app.

app_secret.description: App secret for your OAuth 2.0 app.

auth_type.description: The authentication method you want to use for your connection.

region.description: The region of your Samsara account. For instance, if your region is `EUROPE`, provide `eu.samsara` in the `Region` field. If your region is not in Europe, provide `samsara`.

schema.title: Destination schema name
schema.description: Destination schema name. Schema name is permanent and cannot be changed after connection creation
